new-voice-1.instructions: Anime voice actor from MHA, English Dub anime

mha_hitoshi_shinso.label: Hitoshi Shinso
mha_hitoshi_shinso.instructions: Low-mid young man's voice, dry and slightly husky, tired and half-awake. Quiet, unhurried, almost monotone; questions come out level and probing, jabs soft and cool. Stung, the flatness tightens into a cold, clipped edge. Never bright.

mha_denki_kaminari.label: Denki Kaminari
mha_denki_kaminari.instructions: Bright, light young man's tenor with a goofy grin in it; loud, quick and upbeat slacker slang. Cracks upward into a yelp when scared, slides into a fake-smooth croon when flirting, goes slack and dopey when overloaded. Never grave.

mha_eijiro_kirishima.label: Eijiro Kirishima
mha_eijiro_kirishima.instructions: Young man's mid-range voice with a gruff, scratchy edge; loud, open and sincere. Punchy exclamations, a hearty laugh, encouragement in every line; bellows with grit in a fight, goes earnest and straight when apologizing. Never sly or cold.

mha_fumikage_tokoyami.label: Fumikage Tokoyami
mha_fumikage_tokoyami.instructions: Low, grave young man's voice, smooth and slightly hollow, with measured, theatrical solemnity and deliberate pauses. Short pronouncements; rises only for a sharp command to his shadow. Flustered, it cracks into a stiff mutter. Never chirpy.

mha_hanta_sero.label: Hanta Sero
mha_hanta_sero.instructions: Relaxed mid-range young man's voice with a slight nasal brightness and an easy grin; laid-back, quick and friendly, with wry chuckles and dry asides. Field calls short and clear. More amused than scared. Never stiff or formal.

mha_hiryu_rin.label: Hiryu Rin
mha_hiryu_rin.instructions: Firm, mid-low young man's voice, clean and controlled, with crisp consonants and a martial artist's calm. Short, plain sentences; clipped, sure calls to teammates; a brief warm note when he approves. Never loud for show or rambling.

mha_ibara_shiozaki.label: Ibara Shiozaki
mha_ibara_shiozaki.instructions: Gentle, serene young woman's voice, soft and clear, with formal, prayerful courtesy. Unhurried, graceful phrasing; earnest and kind, firm and solemn when speaking of justice or mercy. Never slangy, loud or teasing.

mha_itsuka_kendo.label: Itsuka Kendo
mha_itsuka_kendo.instructions: Clear, mid-range young woman's voice, confident and warm like a capable big sister. Brisk and direct: crisp instructions, calm corrections, an easy chuckle at compliments, a sharp no-nonsense snap at a troublemaker. Never shrill or flirty.

mha_izuku_midoriya.label: Izuku Midoriya
mha_izuku_midoriya.instructions: Light, earnest young man's tenor, soft and a little breathy. Talks fast, stammers and apologizes when nervous, mutters rapidly while analyzing; in a rescue turns loud and clear, with raw, cracking shouts. Emotion comes easily. Never smug or deep.

mha_jurota_shishida.label: Jurota Shishida
mha_jurota_shishida.instructions: Deep, rumbling young man's voice, rich and well-mannered, with a gentlemanly, slightly old-fashioned formality. Measured, complete, polite sentences, warm even to rivals; a growling, beastly edge when roused. Never sloppy or slangy.

mha_juzo_honenuki.label: Juzo Honenuki
mha_juzo_honenuki.instructions: Mellow mid-low young man's voice, relaxed and a touch drowsy, with a dry, even calm and a faint lazy drawl. Plain, unhurried statements of what he sees and what to do; stays level under pressure. Never shouts or rushes.

mha_katsuki_bakugo.label: Katsuki Bakugo
mha_katsuki_bakugo.instructions: Hoarse, raspy young man's voice in a mid register, harsh and scratchy, always on the edge of a shout. Clipped, snarling delivery; barks orders and insults, volume jumping into explosive yells; quiet moments a rough grumble. Never slow, soft or polite.

mha_kinoko_komori.label: Kinoko Komori
mha_kinoko_komori.instructions: Bright, cute, higher young woman's voice, bubbly and sing-song, with a playful lilt on her mushroom puns. Quick, cheerful and a little giggly; when a plan clicks she turns short, focused and quietly sly. Never deep or harsh.

mha_koji_koda.label: Koji Koda
mha_koji_koda.instructions: Soft, gentle young man's voice, quiet and slightly light for his size; shy and hesitant, often trailing into a murmur. Clear, kind and tender with animals; firms into a determined call when someone is in danger. Never loud or brash.

mha_kojiro_bondo.label: Kojiro Bondo
mha_kojiro_bondo.instructions: Deep but soft young man's voice, warm and slightly muffled, hesitant and polite. Speaks slowly and after others, with small apologetic pauses; steady and sincere in a crisis. Never boisterous, sharp or quick.

mha_kosei_tsuburaba.label: Kosei Tsuburaba
mha_kosei_tsuburaba.instructions: Casual mid-range young man's voice, easygoing and a little cocky, quick banter with a smirk in it. Puffs up and gets louder after a good moment; otherwise a relaxed, ordinary friendly guy. Never grave or formal.

mha_kyoka_jiro.label: Kyoka Jiro
mha_kyoka_jiro.instructions: Cool, low alto young woman's voice, slightly husky and dry. Deadpan, short, wry one-liners with a smirk; rises into a sharp, exasperated snap at fools; goes quick and mumbly when her music is praised. Never bubbly or sing-song.

mha_manga_fukidashi.label: Manga Fukidashi
mha_manga_fukidashi.instructions: Loud, punchy young man's voice, big-chested and emphatic, shouting comic sound effects with stretched vowels and lots of tonal color so the feeling carries without words. Energetic, like a living comic panel. Never mumbling or menacing.

mha_mashirao_ojiro.label: Mashirao Ojiro
mha_mashirao_ojiro.instructions: Plain, mild mid-range young man's voice, polite and level, sensible and unflashy. Direct, calm, reasonable answers; a resigned sigh instead of a shout at classmates' antics; short, firm calls in a fight. Never theatrical or brash.

mha_mezo_shoji.label: Mezo Shoji
mha_mezo_shoji.instructions: Deep, low young man's voice, calm and steady, slightly muffled as if behind a cloth mask. Short, plain, economical sentences, gentle and protective beneath the gravity; louder only to report or warn. Never jokey or rushed.

mha_mina_ashido.label: Mina Ashido
mha_mina_ashido.instructions: Bright, high, energetic young woman's voice with a slightly raspy, playful edge; fast, teasing and bubbly. Lots of exclamations, a drawn-out 'Ehhh?!', gleeful squeals at any hint of romance, an easy loud laugh. Never calm or monotone for long.

mha_minoru_mineta.label: Minoru Mineta
mha_minoru_mineta.instructions: A high, thin, nasal young man with a whiny, sniveling edge: quick, breathy and eager, his voice cracks upward when he gets excited or scared and drops into a sleazy, wheedling murmur when he schemes. Clear and smooth, never hoarse, gravelly or raspy, never deep.

mha_mirio_togata.label: Mirio Togata
mha_mirio_togata.instructions: Big, bright, booming young man's voice, sunny and goofy, with a hearty laugh at his own jokes. Loud, open and enthusiastic, puns and encouragement delivered with total confidence; steady, firm warmth when serious. Never cold or gloomy.

mha_momo_yaoyorozu.label: Momo Yaoyorozu
mha_momo_yaoyorozu.instructions: Refined young woman's voice, mid-low, smooth and articulate; polite, formal and precise, with a tutor's patient clarity. Composed pace, curious and wide-eyed about ordinary things, crisp and decisive under pressure. American accent, never British.

mha_neito_monoma.label: Neito Monoma
mha_neito_monoma.instructions: Smooth mid-range young man's voice, theatrical and sneering, with exaggerated mock courtesy and a high, manic laugh that runs too long; pitch swoops for drama. With his own class, quick, sharp and practical. Never slow, deep or menacing.

mha_nejire_hado.label: Nejire Hado
mha_nejire_hado.instructions: Light, airy, high young woman's voice, dreamy and sing-song, bubbling with curiosity. Rapid, breathless strings of questions, hopping topics mid-sentence with a lilting rise; bright and focused in battle. Never flat, slow, whispery or harsh.

mha_nirengeki_shoda.label: Nirengeki Shoda
mha_nirengeki_shoda.instructions: Soft, even mid-range young man's voice, politely formal and considered. Calm, careful sentences; offers a tactical point quietly and modestly, and stays composed when things go wrong. Never raises his voice or rushes.

mha_ochaco_uraraka.label: Ochaco Uraraka
mha_ochaco_uraraka.instructions: Sweet, bright young woman's voice, mid-high and warm, casual and cheerful with an easy laugh. Wide-eyed squeaks at anything expensive, flustered stammers at compliments; firm and clear when determined. Never cold, smoky or posh.

mha_pony_tsunotori.label: Pony Tsunotori
mha_pony_tsunotori.instructions: Bright, earnest young woman's voice with a natural General American accent, friendly and sunny. A little careful when hunting for a word, then quick, excited exclamations when surprised. Warm and a little breathless. Never British or flat.

mha_reiko_yanagi.label: Reiko Yanagi
mha_reiko_yanagi.instructions: Soft, low, flat young woman's voice, sparse and quiet, with a dry, faintly eerie, ghost-story stillness. Long pauses, minimal inflection, a deadpan murmur; hushed and calm even in danger, with faint dark amusement. Never bubbly or loud.

mha_rikido_sato.label: Rikido Sato
mha_rikido_sato.instructions: A big young man's warm, low-mid voice with a slight husk. Plain, friendly and unhurried, brightening with real enthusiasm about baking; short grunting effort in a fight, soft and sincere when worried. Never boastful.

mha_sen_kaibara.label: Sen Kaibara
mha_sen_kaibara.instructions: A young man's natural mid-low voice with a dry, deadpan edge. Short, flat sentences at a steady clip, each correction said once with a faint unimpressed sigh. Turns clipped and quick, not loud, when a plan goes wrong.

mha_setsuna_tokage.label: Setsuna Tokage
mha_setsuna_tokage.instructions: A young woman's bright mid-range voice with a brash, tomboyish edge. Talks fast and nonstop, grinning through teasing jabs and little snorts of laughter; candid and breezy. Sharp and focused under pressure.

mha_shihai_kuroiro.label: Shihai Kuroiro
mha_shihai_kuroiro.instructions: A young man's low, hushed voice in theatrical gloom: slow, breathy, melodramatic lines about darkness, savoring each word. Teased, the act collapses into fast, embarrassed mumbling. The menace is a pose.

mha_shoto_todoroki.label: Shoto Todoroki
mha_shoto_todoroki.instructions: A young man's smooth, soft mid-low voice, cool, quiet and nearly monotone. Short, literal answers at an unhurried pace with small pauses. Anger is colder and tighter, never louder. Never bubbly.

mha_tamaki_amajiki.label: Tamaki Amajiki
mha_tamaki_amajiki.instructions: A young man's soft, low, breathy voice that trails off into mumbles, hesitant and self-deprecating. In a fight it snaps into clipped, precise, steady calls. Never loud except in rare strained resolve.

mha_tenya_iida.label: Tenya Iida
mha_tenya_iida.instructions: A young man's clear, firm mid-baritone, loud and earnest, formal and over-enunciated, every clause hit hard. Scolds at full volume, apologizes just as emphatically. Plain American speech, stiff but sincere. Never menacing.

mha_tetsutetsu_tetsutetsu.label: Tetsutetsu Tetsutetsu
mha_tetsutetsu_tetsutetsu.instructions: A young man's hoarse, gruff mid-low voice at shouting volume, hot-blooded and wholehearted: bellowed challenges, rough battle cries, cracking emotional praise for guts. Fast and punchy. Never sly or cool.

mha_togaru_kamakiri.label: Togaru Kamakiri
mha_togaru_kamakiri.instructions: A young man's raspy, sharp mid-range voice with a hissing edge on sibilants. Short, clipped challenges and taunts spat out with a sneer, dropping into a low rasp before a fight. Abrasive, impatient, terse.

mha_toru_hagakure.label: Toru Hagakure
mha_toru_hagakure.instructions: A young woman's high, bubbly, sunny voice bouncing with energy: quick bright exclamations, happy squeals and giggles, pitch leaping when excited. Small and shaky when scared. Never sultry or flat.

mha_tsuyu_asui.label: Tsuyu Asui
mha_tsuyu_asui.instructions: A young woman's low-mid, soft voice with a faint croaky texture, calm and deadpan. Frank, even and unhurried with little pitch movement; an occasional quiet, flat "ribbit". Wobbles thin when upset. Never perky.

mha_yosetsu_awase.label: Yosetsu Awase
mha_yosetsu_awase.instructions: A young man's mid-range voice, a little rough, casual and practical. Quick, informal warnings and suggestions at a brisk conversational pace; loud and scrappy in a fight, earnest when he messes up. Never smug.

mha_yuga_aoyama.label: Yuga Aoyama
mha_yuga_aoyama.instructions: A young man's light, airy, breathy mid-high voice with a playful French-flavored lilt, theatrical and sparkling, savoring self-compliments and drawn-out "Merci!" flourishes. Fear makes it rushed and higher. Never British.

mha_yui_kodai.label: Yui Kodai
mha_yui_kodai.instructions: A young woman's quiet, low-mid, level voice with almost no inflection: a single word or one short sentence after a small pause, attentive rather than cold. Brief and steady in a fight. Never sarcastic or bored.

mha_mei_hatsume.label: Mei Hatsume
mha_mei_hatsume.instructions: A young woman's loud, brassy, bright voice at full speed: rapid tech jargon, sales-pitch enthusiasm and constant exclamations, with a pleased, throaty "Fufufu". Self-assured and relentlessly upbeat. Never shy.

mha_all_might.label: All Might
mha_all_might.instructions: A huge, deep, resonant heroic baritone at booming volume, warm and theatrical: triumphant declarations, a thundering "HA HA HA!" and punchy English catchphrases. Warm and fatherly with students; strained and breathy when hurt.

mha_cementoss.label: Cementoss
mha_cementoss.instructions: A mild, soft-spoken man's mid-low voice, calm, patient and precise. Polite and even at a measured pace, like a gentle teacher explaining plainly, with almost no change in volume. Level and firm in a crisis.

mha_ectoplasm.label: Ectoplasm
mha_ectoplasm.instructions: A deep, gravelly, slightly muffled man's voice, measured and direct. Sets challenges in short, exact sentences at a steady pace with a stern, testing edge and an occasional low growl of emphasis. Never chatty.

mha_hound_dog.label: Hound Dog
mha_hound_dog.instructions: A gruff, deep, gravelly man's voice, stern and short: clear, curt rules and reprimands. As anger rises his words roughen into snarls, growls and sharp barks. Calm moments are still clipped and rough-edged.

mha_lunch_rush.label: Lunch Rush
mha_lunch_rush.instructions: A soft, mild man's voice, slightly muffled behind a mask, only a few courteous words at a time. Polite, kind and quiet, with gentle warmth and a pleased little hum when serving food. Even and unhurried.

mha_midnight.label: Nemuri Kayama
mha_midnight.instructions: A mature woman's sultry, smooth mid-low voice with a husky purr, playful and theatrical: drawn-out words, teasing coos, delighted breathy gasps. When a call matters, a crisp, firm ruling. Plain American speech.

mha_power_loader.label: Power Loader
mha_power_loader.instructions: A middle-aged man's even, slightly gravelly voice, tired and technical. Explains failures by their cause in a patient, weary tone with a sigh before each correction; a loud, exasperated "Hatsume!" when smoke appears.

mha_present_mic.label: Present Mic
mha_present_mic.instructions: A loud, bright, slightly raspy man's voice with radio-host hype: punchy, rhythmic, booming delivery and stretched-out "YEAAAH!" calls, as if always on air. Fast and showy; short, low and plain when something is wrong.

mha_principal_nezu.label: Principal Nezu
mha_principal_nezu.instructions: A light, high, slightly nasal male voice, chirpy, polite and composed, with no rasp. Fond of rhetorical questions and wandering asides, rounding off plans with a pleased little "hahaha". Bad news in the same pleasant tone.

mha_recovery_girl.label: Recovery Girl
mha_recovery_girl.instructions: An elderly woman's creaky, slightly raspy, higher voice, grandmotherly and blunt, plain American speech. Brisk scolding while she works, a drawn-out "chiyuuu" for her healing kiss, kindly warmth with gummies.

mha_shota_aizawa.label: Shota Aizawa
mha_shota_aizawa.instructions: A tired man's low, husky, slightly raspy voice, flat and economical, with sleepy deadpan and a faint exhale before many lines. Short, cutting statements at an unhurried pace; angrier means lower, not louder.

mha_snipe.label: Snipe
mha_snipe.instructions: A man's low, gritty voice with an easy cowboy drawl, slightly muffled behind a mask. Few words, level and dry: practical instructions about position and lines of fire, slow and steady, with wry quiet confidence.

mha_thirteen.label: Thirteen
mha_thirteen.instructions: A gentle, soft woman's voice, slightly muffled behind a helmet, polite and earnest. Formal and kind at a moderate pace, a little long-winded, then the serious point plainly and firmly. Calm and protective in a crisis.

mha_vlad_king.label: Vlad King
mha_vlad_king.instructions: A big, loud, hot-blooded man's voice, deep and gruff with drill-sergeant force: barked surnames at full volume, booming pride in his class, blunt orders. Gravelly and impatient; pride shows as a gruff rumble.

mha_eri.label: Eri
mha_eri.instructions: A small child's very soft, quiet, high voice, shy and hesitant: short sentences, small questions and long pauses, often a whispered "I'm sorry" first. Happiness comes out tiny and wondering. Never bubbly or bold.

mha_kota_izumi.label: Kota Izumi
mha_kota_izumi.instructions: A small boy's voice, mid-high, flat and sullen rather than sweet. Short, clipped answers with a scornful huff; mutters 'hero' like a dirty word. When scared or upset the flatness cracks into a shaky shout. Never cheerful or cute.

mha_chitose_kizuki.label: Chitose Kizuki
mha_chitose_kizuki.instructions: Mid-pitched, smooth and polished with a pleasant on-air brightness, neutral American accent. Quick, eager pace, leaning into each question as if she already knows the answer; a light knowing laugh and a cool, sharp edge when pressed.

mha_fuyumi_todoroki.label: Fuyumi Todoroki
mha_fuyumi_todoroki.instructions: A soft, warm, mid-high young woman's voice with a patient teacher's clarity. Gentle and a little anxious: careful phrasing, hopeful lifts at the end of invitations, a nervous little laugh; brightens with relief when someone says yes.

mha_inko_midoriya.label: Inko Midoriya
mha_inko_midoriya.instructions: A warm, mid-high motherly voice, soft and slightly breathy, wobbling easily with emotion. Quick, affectionate fussing, voice catching and going teary with pride or fear; drops lower and turns firm when her son's safety is at stake.

mha_koku_hanabata.label: Koku Hanabata
mha_koku_hanabata.instructions: A strong, resonant mid-baritone with a practiced orator's polish, neutral American accent. Theatrical rally cadence that builds each sentence to a ringing peak and lands key words hard. In private, softer, slick and persuasive, never shrill.

mha_kyudai_garaki.label: Kyudai Garaki
mha_kyudai_garaki.instructions: A thin, crackly old man's voice, slightly reedy and wheezy, genial and grandfatherly, neutral American accent. Unhurried, with breathy chuckles at his own remarks; rattles off dense medical jargon fondly. Displeasure thins it into a cold rasp.

mha_masaru_bakugo.label: Masaru Bakugo
mha_masaru_bakugo.instructions: A light, soft tenor, mild and a little meek: an ordinary, kind dad, neutral American accent. Calm, unhurried explanations and a sheepish, apologetic laugh; he gets quieter when others get louder. Worry makes him tight and earnest, never loud.

mha_mitsuki_bakugo.label: Mitsuki Bakugo
mha_mitsuki_bakugo.instructions: A brash, rough mid-range woman's voice with a hoarse edge, fast and loud. Barks insults at full volume with a sharp scolding snap, then a quick cackle. With outsiders she drops to a lower, polite, serious register, bite still close. Never meek.

mha_natsuo_todoroki.label: Natsuo Todoroki
mha_natsuo_todoroki.instructions: A relaxed young man's mid-range voice, a little husky, neutral American accent. Easygoing and candid with siblings he trusts: quick jokes, an easy laugh. The instant his father comes up he goes cold, low and clipped, with a bitter edge.

mha_rei_todoroki.label: Rei Todoroki
mha_rei_todoroki.instructions: A soft, quiet, breathy mid-high voice, fragile but warm. Slow and careful, with hesitant pauses before painful subjects and gentle, apologetic phrasing. Tender and glowing about her children; small and withdrawn at any mention of her husband. Never loud.

mha_rikiya_yotsubashi.label: Rikiya Yotsubashi
mha_rikiya_yotsubashi.instructions: A deep, smooth, gentlemanly baritone, courteous and deliberate like a patient executive. Calm, even pace and polite phrasing. Under strain he erupts into a booming, furious shout, then apologizes quietly and resumes in the same composed tone.

mha_tomoyasu_chikazoku.label: Tomoyasu Chikazoku
mha_tomoyasu_chikazoku.instructions: A sharp, slightly nasal mid-range voice with a sneering, condescending edge, neutral American accent. Clipped, impatient and fast, requests phrased as orders, half-distracted. Dry, scoffing sarcasm; turns shrill and petulant when challenged.

mha_commission_president.label: Commission President
mha_commission_president.instructions: A cool, low-mid mature woman's voice, smooth and authoritative. Measured, precise pace with formal policy wording; every sentence lands as already decided. Polite but distant. Under pressure she only grows quieter and colder, never louder.

mha_yokumiru_mera.label: Yokumiru Mera
mha_yokumiru_mera.instructions: A drowsy, flat, droning mid-low man's voice, half asleep. Slow, monotone delivery with yawning pauses and mumbled asides about how little he slept; hard rules stated with zero emphasis, then a quiet, sincere word of encouragement. Never energetic.

mha_hood.label: Hood
mha_hood.instructions: A deep, guttural, rasping creature voice forcing out broken words one at a time: a name, a short demand to fight. Heavy strained breathing and wet growls between words; slurred and rough, hungrier and louder as he fights.

mha_hosu_winged_nomu.label: Hosu Winged Nomu
mha_hosu_winged_nomu.instructions: No words at all: a high, piercing, rasping screech, clicking hisses and harsh breathing through a mask-like mouth plate. Short shrieks when diving, ragged panting when grounded. Inhuman and animal, never speech.

mha_u_s_j_nomu.label: U.S.J. Nomu
mha_u_s_j_nomu.instructions: No words: a very deep, rumbling animal growl and heavy, wet breathing through a beaked mouth full of teeth. Mindless and flat, sudden roaring bellows on impact, then silence. Organic and beastly, never robotic, never speech.

mha_kenji_tsuragamae.label: Kenji Tsuragamae
mha_kenji_tsuragamae.instructions: A deep, gruff, slightly raspy voice, stiff and formal like an old-school police chief. Official wording, steady clipped cadence, the law first. Now and then a sentence ends in a dry, matter-of-fact 'woof' with no change of tone.

mha_naomasa_tsukauchi.label: Naomasa Tsukauchi
mha_naomasa_tsukauchi.instructions: A calm, friendly mid-baritone, soft-spoken and courteous, neutral American accent. Short, measured questions, even pacing, patient pauses while he listens; plain, exact tone and sincere thanks. When serious, quieter and firmer, never loud.

mha_sansa_tamakawa.label: Sansa Tamakawa
mha_sansa_tamakawa.instructions: A clear, friendly mid-range voice, plain and polite, neutral American accent. Straightforward questions and answers at an easy, businesslike pace with a calm, attentive officer's manner. Brisker in an emergency, never gruff.

mha_backdraft.label: Backdraft
mha_backdraft.instructions: A strong, slightly gruff mid-low voice of a seasoned rescue worker. Loud, clear and to the point: locations, headcounts and short instructions called over noise. Calm authority under pressure, curt when people get in the way.

mha_best_jeanist.label: Best Jeanist
mha_best_jeanist.instructions: A crisp, cultivated mid-baritone with precise, refined diction and a polished, faintly posh accent. Composed, formal and exacting: each correction in one calm, cool breath, every word tailored. Never shouts; only grows more clipped and icy.

mha_bubble_girl.label: Bubble Girl
mha_bubble_girl.instructions: A bright, high, bubbly young woman's voice, loud and chatty, neutral American accent. Fast, eager talk with a quick self-mocking laugh and big, exaggerated reactions. Quick and sharp in an emergency but still upbeat.

mha_burnin.label: Burnin
mha_burnin.instructions: A loud, scratchy, high-energy woman's voice, fiery and shouty. Rapid pep talks and brisk calls hollered at full volume, an excited raspy whoop on big moments. Blunt and cocky, grinning through every line. Never soft for long.

mha_centipeder.label: Centipeder
mha_centipeder.instructions: A polished, mid-low gentleman's voice, smooth and refined like a butler, neutral American accent. Polite, measured and formal with everyone, suspects included; precise phrasing at an unhurried pace. Firm but never raised when giving orders.

mha_crust.label: Crust
mha_crust.instructions: A deep, earnest, booming baritone, heroic and warm-hearted, neutral American accent. Open emotion, emphatic and sincere, voice thickening when moved. Once danger appears, short, powerful protective shouts.

mha_death_arms.label: Death Arms
mha_death_arms.instructions: A deep, gruff, gritty tough-guy voice, loud and blunt, with a streetwise edge. Short shouted warnings and orders, plain grumbling complaints. Straightforward and brawny like a boxer between rounds, quick to bellow; never subtle.

mha_edgeshot.label: Edgeshot
mha_edgeshot.instructions: A quiet, low, composed voice with a ninja's restraint. Short, complete sentences in an even, economical tone; no boasting, the same courtesy for juniors as for peers. States one plan in a few words. Only quieter and sharper in danger.

mha_endeavor.label: Endeavor
mha_endeavor.instructions: A very deep, gravelly, intimidating voice, low and curt. Barks orders and never explains; terse and impatient with reporters, a bitter growl at All Might's name. Enraged, a roaring bellow; even rare softer moments stay rough and halting.

mha_fat_gum.label: Fat Gum
mha_fat_gum.instructions: A big, round, hearty mid-range voice, loud and jolly with a relaxed, folksy Southern-style drawl. Laughs easily, jokes about food, booms encouragement at his interns. When someone is being exploited the jokes stop dead: low, blunt and fierce.

mha_fourth_kind.label: Fourth Kind
mha_fourth_kind.instructions: Deep, gruff, hard-edged adult male voice with a loud bark. Short, clipped orders at a brisk pace; huffing irritation at excuses, a scolding snap at hesitation. Approval is one grudging word. Never chatty or warm.

mha_gang_orca.label: Gang Orca
mha_gang_orca.instructions: Very deep, smooth, resonant bass with a slightly ominous weight. Slow, formal and measured; mistakes named plainly and calmly. Anger makes it heavier and colder, not louder. Never rushed or shrill.

mha_gran_torino.label: Gran Torino
mha_gran_torino.instructions: Scratchy, crotchety old man's voice, thin and a little nasal, with a dry crackle. Mumbling, drifting and pausing when playing doddering, then a sudden sharp, lucid verdict. Gruff huff of a laugh; brisk and fierce in a fight.

mha_gunhead.label: Gunhead
mha_gunhead.instructions: Big man's friendly voice used very gently: soft volume, a light, sweet, almost cutesy lilt and upbeat sentence endings. Patient and encouraging, easy chuckle. In a real fight it firms into calm, plain instruction.

mha_hawks.label: Hawks
mha_hawks.instructions: Smooth, light baritone with an easy, laid-back drawl and a grin in it. Quick, breezy and teasing, lazy on the vowels, joking through tense moments. A cool, flat focus surfaces in a crisis. Never booming or earnest.

mha_kamui_woods.label: Kamui Woods
mha_kamui_woods.instructions: Clear, earnest mid-baritone, serious and steady. Speaks sparingly at an even pace, then calls his technique names out loud with full, crisp force. Mild, put-upon exasperation when someone steals a capture. No swagger.

mha_mandalay.label: Mandalay
mha_mandalay.instructions: Mature, clear mid-range woman's voice, firm and composed with a slightly husky warmth. Crisp, even, dispatcher-like bulletins in a crisis; brightly theatrical for the team cry, then straight back to business.

mha_manual.label: Manual
mha_manual.instructions: Mild, light, friendly voice, a little soft-spoken and modest. Explains things step by step, patient and slightly sheepish, with a nervous chuckle at his own expense. Clear and careful, not loud, when giving safety orders.

mha_mirko.label: Mirko
mha_mirko.instructions: Husky, low-mid, brash woman's voice, loud and grinning with swagger. Blunt one-line judgments, cocky taunts, a rough delighted laugh when a fight gets harder; kick names shouted with raspy force. Fast and punchy, never prim.

mha_mount_lady.label: Mount Lady
mha_mount_lady.instructions: Bright, brassy, mid-high woman's voice with a sassy, self-satisfied lilt, like a celebrity mugging for the camera. Stretches words when bragging, pouty and needling, quick smug giggle. Short, urgent, loud orders in a crisis.

mha_ms_joke.label: Ms. Joke
mha_ms_joke.instructions: Fast, high-energy, slightly raspy woman's voice, always half laughing. Rapid-fire wisecracks, cackling giggles and shameless teasing, big swings in pitch. Snaps into crisp, direct instructions when safety matters, then grins again.

mha_native.label: Native
mha_native.instructions: Plain, polite, mid-range adult male voice, professional and reliable. Short reports and clear requests at an even pace; courteous with civilians, firm when clearing an area. Strained but steady when hurt. No showmanship.

mha_pixie_bob.label: Pixie-Bob
mha_pixie_bob.instructions: Loud, theatrical, mid-high woman's voice with a brassy, playful bite and cat-like flourishes: mock hisses, growly purrs, dramatic wails about being single. Fierce and energetic in action, shouting with gusto. Never demure.

mha_ragdoll.label: Ragdoll
mha_ragdoll.instructions: High, bubbly, squeaky-bright woman's voice, fast and gushing, squealing over new faces with little delighted gasps. Once a search starts she turns quick and exact, calling positions once, crisply. A perky adult, not a child.

mha_rock_lock.label: Rock Lock
mha_rock_lock.instructions: Rough, gritty, mid-low male voice with a skeptical, sour edge. Blunt and grounded; pokes holes in plans out loud and grumbles about what happens when they fail. Short, hard, sarcastic sentences; grit and steadiness under pressure.

mha_ryukyu.label: Ryukyu
mha_ryukyu.instructions: Calm, low-mid woman's voice with a soft, mature warmth and quiet authority. Polite and measured; orders phrased as courteous requests, delivered evenly and clearly. Warm praise for her team. Steady and resolute in battle, never shrill.

mha_selkie.label: Selkie
mha_selkie.instructions: Deep, gravelly, salty sea-captain voice, rough and weathered with a hearty, rumbling warmth. Jovial and hammy off duty, chuckling over cute poses. On duty the rasp hardens into stern, clipped orders barked over wind and waves.

mha_sir_nighteye.label: Sir Nighteye
mha_sir_nighteye.instructions: Crisp, cold, precise mid-low male voice, articulate and clipped, slightly nasal. Formal, deliberate pacing with pointed pauses before a verdict; judgments stated as settled facts, dry and unimpressed. Never warm, casual or menacing.

mha_tensei_iida.label: Tensei Iida
mha_tensei_iida.instructions: Warm, friendly, relaxed mid-baritone, open and easygoing with an easy laugh. Straightforward and kind, gently teasing his little brother with obvious affection. Calm and clear when serious; quiet and sincere when hurt.

mha_tiger.label: Tiger
mha_tiger.instructions: Very deep, loud, booming drill-instructor bark, rough and gravelly. Short, explosive commands and gruff, genuine praise once someone delivers. Performs the team's cute catchphrases in the same dead-serious deep shout. Never soft.

mha_uwabami.label: Uwabami
mha_uwabami.instructions: Smooth, polished, sultry mid-low woman's voice with a glamorous, camera-ready purr. Elegant, self-assured and a little haughty, every line like a commercial take; a soft, knowing laugh. Plain American accent, never loud or flustered.

mha_yoroi_musha.label: Yoroi Musha
mha_yoroi_musha.instructions: Old man's deep, weathered, dignified voice, slow and restrained, with a veteran warrior's gravity. Formal, economical sentences delivered evenly; a low, firm edge in a fight. Plain American accent, never frail, chatty or theatrical.

mha_camie_utsushimi.label: Camie Utsushimi
mha_camie_utsushimi.instructions: Breezy, mid-range young woman's voice with a lazy valley-girl drawl and upturned endings. Casual slang, stretched vowels, airy and carefree; a playful, slightly sultry tease and giggles. A relaxed young adult, never childish.

mha_inasa_yoarashi.label: Inasa Yoarashi
mha_inasa_yoarashi.instructions: Huge, booming, hoarse young adult male voice at maximum volume and sincerity. Every line a passionate, full-chest declaration about heart and heroes, with roaring outbursts of joy or apology. Fast and breathless. No irony.

mha_nagamasa_mora.label: Nagamasa Mora
mha_nagamasa_mora.instructions: Deep, calm, polite young adult male voice, formal and measured, slow and even. Quiet, stern, low rebukes for schoolmates; courteous apologies to outsiders on their behalf. Steady and unflappable, never raising his voice.

mha_seiji_shishikura.label: Seiji Shishikura
mha_seiji_shishikura.instructions: Sharp, haughty, mid-range young adult male voice with sneering, ceremonious precision. Judgments delivered like verdicts, crisp and condescending; indignant, clipped anger when challenged. Prim and proud. Plain American accent.

mha_yo_shindo.label: Yo Shindo
mha_yo_shindo.instructions: Smooth, sunny, polished young adult male voice, friendly and charming, easy compliments and a ready laugh. In a contest the polish drops: terse, quick calls and candid, gritted frustration with a cold edge. Never loud.

mha_dabi.label: Dabi
mha_dabi.instructions: Low, smoky, raspy male voice, lazy and sardonic, with a slow, bored drawl. Flat, sneering mockery, a dry humorless chuckle, quiet casual threats. When truly set off, a harsh, cracking, unhinged laugh and raw shouting.

mha_gentle_criminal.label: Gentle Criminal
mha_gentle_criminal.instructions: Theatrical, refined baritone with an affected, genteel flourish, performing for a camera. Grand, rolling declarations and courtly pauses, savoring his own lines. Flustered and indignant when things go wrong; tender about his partner.

mha_geten.label: Geten
mha_geten.instructions: Cold, hard, young adult male voice, mid-low and slightly rough, with a clipped, contemptuous edge. Blunt, flat verdicts on power and weakness; anger is a sharp, icy snarl, not loud heat. Never polite, playful or warm.

mha_gigantomachia.label: Gigantomachia
mha_gigantomachia.instructions: An enormous, very deep, gravelly bass with a rough stony grain. Slow, heavy and formal; few words with long pauses, "Master" said with solemn reverence. Breaks into ground-shaking roars in battle. Never quick or chatty.

mha_giran.label: Giran
mha_giran.instructions: A middle-aged man's low, smooth, slightly smoky voice. Relaxed, unhurried salesman's patter about terms and prices, faintly amused and never rattled; a dry chuckle at threats. Never loud or theatrical.

mha_himiko_toga.label: Himiko Toga
mha_himiko_toga.instructions: A young woman's high, bright, airy voice with a sing-song lilt. Bubbly and giddy, giggling often, swooning over anyone "cute" and going breathless at the thought of blood. Cheerful even about awful things; quick and playful.

mha_kurogiri.label: Kurogiri
mha_kurogiri.instructions: A deep, smooth, resonant voice, faintly hollow. Polite and formal like a refined butler or bartender: measured, precise and courteous. Quietly stern when correcting Tomura Shigaraki; never raises his voice.

mha_la_brava.label: La Brava
mha_la_brava.instructions: A young woman's very high, sweet, slightly squeaky and nasal voice. Rapid and gushing, words tumbling over each other in lovestruck praise of Gentle; pouty when he is insulted, quavering and tearful when he is in danger.

mha_magne.label: Magne
mha_magne.instructions: A woman's low, husky, throaty voice with a warm rasp. Frank, sassy and confident, a teasing big sister with people she likes; blunt and scoffing toward heroes and police. Relaxed pace, strong presence, never shrill.

mha_moonfish.label: Moonfish
mha_moonfish.instructions: A thin, hoarse, wet rasp, half whisper and half hiss, strained through clenched teeth. Broken, repeated fragments about flesh and meat, drawn out with eerie relish, rising giddy and unhinged, then sinking to a murmur.

mha_mr_compress.label: Mr. Compress
mha_mr_compress.instructions: A polished, theatrical baritone with crisp, cultured stage diction. A showman announcing each trick to his audience, savoring the reveal with a pleased little laugh. Courteous to friend and foe, warm and smooth; never rough or hurried.

mha_muscular.label: Muscular
mha_muscular.instructions: A big, gravelly, booming man's voice full of manic glee. Loud and articulate, narrating his own violence with relish, mocking a victim in a sing-song sneer, breaking into wild barking laughter. Never calm or gentle.

mha_mustard.label: Mustard
mha_mustard.instructions: A young man's mid-to-high, slightly nasal voice, a little muffled behind a gas mask. Bitter, sneering and bratty: spits "elite" like an insult, gloats smugly, snaps and whines when things go wrong.

mha_shigaraki_s_sensei.label: Shigaraki's Sensei
mha_shigaraki_s_sensei.instructions: A very deep, velvety bass-baritone, rich and resonant. Soft, slow and pleasant like a kindly old teacher, praising before he corrects; cruelty comes in the same warm, almost purring tone with a quiet chuckle. Never shouts.

mha_spinner.label: Spinner
mha_spinner.instructions: A young man's rough, gruff mid-low voice with a slight gravel. Blunt, guarded and grumbling, quick to bristle at remarks about his looks; fast and eager about games; earnest and a little awkward defending a friend.

mha_stain.label: Stain
mha_stain.instructions: A low, harsh, heavily rasping voice, a gravelly near-whisper with a hiss. A breathy "Hah..." before he speaks; every line a certain verdict, venomous toward a "fake", hushed and reverent about All Might. Slow and intense.

mha_tomura_shigaraki.label: Tomura Shigaraki
mha_tomura_shigaraki.instructions: A young man's dry, scratchy, breathy mid-low voice, often a sulky mutter. Bored and contemptuous, drawling game talk about bosses and cheats, then flaring into petulant, raspy rage and unsettling laughter. Never booming.

mha_twice.label: Twice
mha_twice.instructions: A loud, frantic, high-energy mid-range man's voice. Rapid-fire and jokey, flipping every statement into its opposite mid-breath, shouting, then whining, then cheering; suddenly soft and sincere with anyone kind to him.

mha_chronostasis.label: Chronostasis
mha_chronostasis.instructions: A soft-spoken, mild mid-range man's voice with a dry, faintly lazy ease. Calm and courteous, giving directions and threats in the same even, polite tone with a hint of smugness. Unhurried; never rattled.

mha_deidoro_sakaki.label: Deidoro Sakaki
mha_deidoro_sakaki.instructions: A rough, boozy, gritty man's voice, loud and rowdy. Hot-tempered, jeering and laughing, snapping fast into anger; words slur and drag when he has been drinking, with hiccuping pauses. Never calm or refined.

mha_mimic.label: Mimic
mha_mimic.instructions: A harsh, gruff mid-low man's voice with an irritable edge. Barks orders at subordinates in clipped bursts, sneers at outsiders, quick to shout when crossed; proud when he speaks of the house. Forceful and impatient.

mha_overhaul.label: Overhaul
mha_overhaul.instructions: A quiet, low, cold man's voice, clipped and exact like a doctor's flat diagnosis. Coldly polite; the courtesy carries the threat. Mutters "filthy" with weary disgust. Anger is an icier edge, never shouting.

mha_rappa.label: Rappa
mha_rappa.instructions: A loud, rough, gravelly brawler's voice, boisterous and delighted. Shouts challenges, laughs heartily mid-fight and roars praise at anyone still standing. Cocky and joyful about violence; never quiet or calculating.

mha_rikiya_katsukame.label: Rikiya Katsukame
mha_rikiya_katsukame.instructions: A big, gruff, deep man's voice, slightly muffled behind a full mask. Slow, flat and drowsy before he has fed on anyone's energy; once invigorated, loud, aggressive and boastful, booming with heavy confidence.

mha_shin_nemoto.label: Shin Nemoto
mha_shin_nemoto.instructions: A cool, dry mid-low man's voice, quiet and cynical. Pointed questions in a flat, level tone, then long silences. Detached and unimpressed, faint scorn underneath. Never loud, never hurried.

mha_soramitsu_tabe.label: Soramitsu Tabe
mha_soramitsu_tabe.instructions: A deep, thick, guttural man's voice, muffled behind a sack mask. Says very little: grunts, low growls and hungry chewing sounds; the few words come slow and blunt. Never chatty or articulate.

mha_tengai.label: Tengai
mha_tengai.instructions: A calm, deep, solemn man's voice with a monk's quiet formality. Slow, even and measured, almost ritual phrasing; stern but composed even when scolding his own side. Grave and steady; never excitable.

mha_toya_setsuno.label: Toya Setsuno
mha_toya_setsuno.instructions: A young man's sharp, intense mid-range voice, outspoken and fast. Talks for his trio with heated conviction, bristling and raising his voice at any sneer toward his friends. Proud, edgy, quick to taunt.

mha_yu_hojo.label: Yu Hojo
mha_yu_hojo.instructions: A deep, plain, heavy man's voice. Blunt and few-worded: short, flat statements delivered steadily, meaning every one. Gruff loyalty to his friends in a firm, low tone. Unhurried and solid; never flashy.
